review:
A shady 5x3 fishing game. Electrical Frames appear at random at the start of a spin, and fish with values interact with them. Imposter Wilds turn into one of several character wilds, each with its own effect, and xWays reveal stacks of two to four symbols, wilds or fish.

Three bonus symbols give eight Dark Water Spins, with more spins for extra symbols and a global fish multiplier. Extreme volatility, 20,000x max, 30% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
